==Description==
'''Forgetten Docks''' is a night-time [[Maps|map]] that takes place in docks.

==Design & Path==
The map takes place in an old European styled village, situated in a river, in between a giant valley. Inside the village were docks that has dozens of holes as they have not been maintained. Buildings in this village are made out of grey bricks and dark brown wood. There are multiple lanterns and candles can be seen on the paths, which light up the map. Wooden barrels and wooden crates are also scattered across the map.

The entrance was located in a cave on one side of the valley, the path traverses the whole village and ends on the other side of the valley.

==Rewards==
The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map.

Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal.

{{Rewards|Hard|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}}

==Strategy==
*There is very little ground and cliff space on this map. Try to be conservative with ground space.
**Beware of the [[Turret]]'s large placement footprint as it may take up valuable ground space.
**Towers like the [[Farm]] and [[Military Base]] should be placed in spots where you do not plan to place your towers in, which is most likely near the exit.

==Trivia==
*This map's name is misspelt; the correct spelling is ''Forgotten Docks''.
*This map's original name was ''Handlerburg''. However, it was changed.
**''Handlerburg'' is German for "''Trading Castle''".
